title: The bird and the tourists
logline: July: the bird on the seawall among tourists, and one of them photographing it with a phone. The first person to see it. The page draws the phone screen blank.

panels.composition: The seawall in July: the small rainbow bird on the wall, a tourist in a sun hat crouched with a phone pointed at it, the phone's screen drawn blank, other tourists not looking.

image.prompt: a single full comic page with no panel borders, spare knowing ink line with economy, muted ochre and slate blue and sea-foam green washes, a small rainbow bird on a seawall in July with a tourist in a sun hat crouched holding a phone toward it whose screen is blank, other tourists walking past not looking, no words

art.line: spare, knowing; economy of line; Era I's black spotting back on purpose in the mill run
art.palette: muted ochres, slate blues, misty sea-foam greens; luminous sunbreaks in the last spring
art.paper: Arches; bristol; the backs of motel registration cards
